completeness.why: All five link functions keep only their provider-specific bank lookup and call linkBankSyncAccount for the whole upgrade/insert, payee, initial sync, handleSyncResponse and sync-event sequence; the preserved differences (GoCardless mask/official name, Pluggy file id, Akahu tables) are passed as explicit arguments, and the unreachable EnableBanking id check is dropped.

interface.why: Parameters map to the real variation (syncSource, externalAccountId, newAccount with optional mask, fileId, syncedTables) and make the preserved inconsistencies explicit at each caller; syncedTables as a free string[] and the conditional mask spread are slightly loose but not speculative.

disguised_duplication.where: The five copies of the link sequence are removed and replaced by calls to linkBankSyncAccount; only the per-provider bank lookups remain, which are not part of the decision.
